title.en: Authorizing the National Grains Authority to Engage in Insurance General Agency and Create a Subsidiary for the Purpose, Provide Funds Therefor and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
The National Grains Authority shall be empowered to act as an insurance general agent and
organize a subsidiary for the same purpose.

In its capacity as an insurance general agent, NGA or its subsidiary is authorized to enter into a
contract of insurance general agency with the Government Service Insurance System and other reputable
private insurance and bonding companies.

The National Grains Authority shall set aside funds necessary for the full implementation of this
Decree to be appropriated from its corporate funds.

The National Grains Authority shall promulgate the rules and regulations, necessary to
implement this Decree.
All laws inconsistent with the herein provisions shall form an integral part hereof.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 24th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
